key_provisions_or_claims: 3rd Global Forum on the Ethics of AI held in Bangkok, with 2,770+ participants from 90 countries
UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI implemented in 70+ countries via the Readiness Assessment Methodology
Launch of Global Network of AI Supervisory Authorities
Launch of Global Network of Civil Society and Academia
Ethics framed as instrumental to innovation
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: UNESCO story summarising the 3rd Global Forum on the Ethics of AI in Bangkok (June 2025). It highlights implementation of the 2021 Recommendation on the Ethics of AI through the Readiness Assessment Methodology and the launch of networks of AI supervisory authorities and of civil society and academia.
annotation.title_clean: Bangkok sets the pace for AI Ethics: Highlights from UNESCO's 3rd Global Forum on the Ethics of AI
annotation.title_en: Bangkok sets the pace for AI Ethics: Highlights from UNESCO's 3rd Global Forum on the Ethics of AI
